turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today we'll be discussing your upcoming knee arthroscopy. Let me start by understanding your medical history. Can you tell me about your knee injury?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes. I twisted my knee during a football game last month. The doctor said I have a torn meniscus that needs fixing. Been having pain and swelling since then.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Now, let's go through your medications. I see you're on Fluticasone nasal spray, Loratadine, and Montelukast. Have you made any changes to these since your last medical review?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Oh, I stopped the Montelukast already. Think it was mid-2023. Still using the Fluticasone spray every day and taking Loratadine for my allergies.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thanks for clarifying that. So Montelukast was discontinued in 2023, and you're continuing Fluticasone and Loratadine. Any known drug allergies?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, no allergies. I can take all medications without problems.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Have you eaten or drunk anything since midnight? We need to ensure you're NPO for general anesthesia.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, nothing since last night dinner. Just water this morning, but I stopped at 6am as instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Any previous anesthesia experiences we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Once, for a minor hand surgery years ago. I woke up with a dry throat but no other issues. They used general anesthesia then too.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Noted. Finally, how's your overall fitness? Can you walk upstairs or do you get short of breath?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I can climb stairs slowly, but long walks make my knee hurt. No breathing problems though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with general anesthesia using sevoflurane and rocuronium, plus a femoral nerve block for pain control. Your allergies and medications are updated in our system now.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sounds good, doctor. I'm ready to get this sorted.
